mainText: Good morning. This is the market briefing for Tuesday, October 13th. Dow futures are up between half a percent and seven-tenths, lifted by UnitedHealth earnings. The S and P 500 is roughly flat, while the Nasdaq 100 is down between half a percent and seven-tenths, as a chip and AI selloff weighs on tech. The 10-year Treasury yield is around five point one nine percent, down about five basis points after yesterday's holiday. Movers: UnitedHealth up two and a half percent after beating expectations and raising guidance. Goldman Sachs up three and a half percent on earnings, with other big banks also higher. Memory chip stocks like Micron and Sandisk down four to six and a half percent on a second day of selling after China's CXMT memory chip breakthrough. Johnson and Johnson, Domino's, and Albertsons each down about two percent after earnings.
